card.name: Antidepressant caregiver warning: 'other indications'
card.fires_on: The word "indications" in the antidepressant warning sentence "Families and caregivers of patients being treated with antidepressants for major depressive disorder or other indications". It is tied to this one repeated warning sentence.

modes.label: Other indications in caregiver warning
modes.description: The word "indications" ends the phrase "major depressive disorder or other" in the suicidality warning for antidepressants.
modes.example: Families and caregivers of patients being treated with antidepressants for major depressive disorder or other<< indications>>, both psychiatric and nonpsychiatric,

card.writes: It seems to push toward second-person words like "your" and "you" and away from first-person words like "I" and "my".
card.plain: It fires on the word "indications" in the standard antidepressant warning to families and caregivers about monitoring patients.
